title: Missing John Hammond: Towles in Trenton while Hammond signed Basie
summary: Hammond hears Kirk's band, but misses the Towles band, and signs Basie.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: "You always miss the boat." But I was happy out there with Nat Toles and they used to come back out there and Andy knew what kind of band we had with Nat Toles' band. So they came back that summer to play Kansas City and we were playing near Kansas City, about 90 miles at a town, Trenton, New Jersey, with the band. So Andy called me down in Trenton, he says, "Look, there's a fella coming down and this cat's got a lot of money and he's got a lot of power and actually, he's looking for a good band." He says, "I know if he hears you all band, you'll be in." So he says, "See if you can get that band down here." So Nat and I went to the cat and he says, "No, no, no," he wouldn't let us off. So Nat and I got in the car and drove down there and that night, that's where I met John Hammond. He was out there at Fairland Park where Andy Kirk was and Andy had made it big, see, and Basie was down to Reno, scuffling with six pieces, he and Buster Smith and I think, Jack Washington, Carl Smith and Joe Jones. That was all Lips had left, see. Lips had a little band. That was all he had.
But John Hammond and Bennie liked what they heard, you know? They had heard it from the Congress Hotel, Bennie was in the Congress and they liked what they heard. So --
Uh-huh. So John just went out there. But if John would have heard our band, Gary, we would have made it. Nat Tōles' band would have made it. That's just -- the wrong thing, and you --
Had you told Hammond about the Nat Tōles -- when you drove up there?

Oh, yeah, we told him about it. We says, 'Can we take you --' We wanted to take him down to -- the next night, we wanted to take ---carry him down to Trenton, New Jersey, where we were playing, but Gatt . . . wouldn't let us off. And he says, 'I can't. I got to be at Bennie's opening tomorrow at the Palomar.' Bennie was opening at the Palomar in Los Angeles. He says, 'I got to be there.' So that night, he went down there and he signed Basie up. So we missed the boat, see, because we had -- our band was in Trenton and he didn't get -- never got a chance to hear it and when he did hear the band -- I'd gone, Sir Charles had gone, Henry Coker had gone and the band wasn't really up to par when he really did hear the band and there's another band that didn't record anything.
